name: Outline
source:
As a part of a "railway club" activity main character together with girl club members go on a photography trip. At the train a ghost of his elder sister appears before him. What will this trip be - a photo tour or a ghost hunt?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
作为“铁路俱乐部”活动的一部分，主角与女孩俱乐部成员一起进行摄影之旅。在火车上，他姐姐的鬼魂出现在他面前。这次旅行会是什么——摄影之旅还是幽灵狩猎？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
